mapper.sql: select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record
mapper.insert: insert into review_delivery_record (task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{runId}, #{projectId}, #{provider}, #{channel}, #{prNumber}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalId}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{failureMessage}, #{attemptCount}, #{lastAttemptTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())
